# trefolio — Full Product Information

> The European investor's portfolio tracker — EU tax reports, stock screener, AI insights, and net worth tracking in 35 languages.

## What is trefolio?

trefolio is a web-based portfolio tracking application designed for European retail investors. It provides a clean, modern dashboard to track stock, ETF, and crypto holdings across multiple exchanges, with real-time quotes, EU-specific tax reports, a stock screener, net worth tracking, dividend tracking, performance metrics, and AI-powered analysis in 35 European languages.

## Target Audience

- Primary: Beginner-to-intermediate retail investors in Europe (roughly 5–50 stocks/ETFs)
- Secondary: Expats with multi-currency portfolios (21 currencies supported)
- Tertiary: Non-English-speaking European investors (35 languages supported)
- Emerging: Dividend-focused investors needing tax reporting (17 countries: DE, FR, ES, NL, IT, GB, US, CH, AT, PT, BE, IE, SE, DK, NO, FI, PL)

## Core Features

### Portfolio Dashboard
- Real-time stock quotes from Yahoo Finance
- Multi-exchange support: NYSE, NASDAQ, XETRA, LSE, Amsterdam (AMS), Madrid (MAD), Copenhagen (OMK), and more
- Multi-currency: 21 currencies (EUR, USD, GBP, CHF, SEK, NOK, DKK, CAD, AUD, NZD, JPY, PLN, CZK, HUF, RON, SGD, HKD, ZAR, TRY, BRL, MXN) with dynamic FX fetching and FX impact tracking
- 4 dashboard themes: Default, Canvas (light & spacious), Terminal (dense monospace), Studio (sidebar + glass effects)
- Daily changes, total value, per-stock breakdowns
- Benchmark comparison with S&P 500, Nasdaq, Dow Jones, and Euro Stoxx 50
- Portfolio growth projections with customizable parameters
- Market ticker bar showing EUR/USD, Bitcoin, Gold, S&P 500, and exchange statuses
- Big market move callouts (≥4% index movement) via marquee, toast, and push notifications

### Tax Reports (Pro)
- Country-specific tax summaries for 17 countries: Germany (Anlage KAP, Vorabpauschale, Teilfreistellung, Sparerpauschbetrag), France (Déclaration 2074, PFU 30%), Spain (Modelo 100/720, wash sale rule), Netherlands (Box 3 wealth tax, deemed returns), Italy (Quadro RT/RW, IVAFE, LIFO cost basis), UK (CGT allowance), US (Schedule D, wash sale), Switzerland (Verrechnungssteuer), Austria (KESt 27.5%), Portugal (IRS Anexo J), Belgium (TOB), Ireland (CGT 33%), Sweden (K4 form), Denmark (Aktieindkomst), Norway (RF-1159), Finland (capital income 30%), Poland (PIT-38)
- AI Tax Assistant with optimization suggestions and data quality checks
- FIFO, LIFO, and average cost basis methods
- CSV export for tax data (realized gains, dividends, form field summaries)

### Stock Screener (Pro)
- Filter 600+ stocks (S&P 500 + STOXX Europe 600) by dividend yield, P/E ratio, sector, market cap, exchange, and country
- 5 preset strategies: All, High Dividend, Value, Growth, Blue Chip
- Theme-aware UI across all 4 dashboard themes
- Own URL routes (/tools/screener) with filter persistence
- Nightly data refresh via automated cron job

### Net Worth Tracking
- Manual entries for real estate, savings accounts, and pension/retirement funds
- Net Worth Overview card on dashboard with total value, category breakdown, and donut chart
- Multi-currency support per asset with optional notes
- Cash section grouped by category (real estate, savings, pension, cash) with subtotals
- Asset allocation donut chart includes all asset types

### Performance Metrics
- TTWROR (Time-Weighted Rate of Return) using the Modified Dietz method
- IRR (Internal Rate of Return) using the XIRR method
- Sharpe Ratio, Max Drawdown, Volatility, Beta (Trefolio)
- Performance explainer showing step-by-step calculations from your real transactions

### Dividend Tracking
- Estimated annual dividend income
- Per-stock yield breakdowns
- 5-year growth projections
- Historical dividend calendar
- Ex-dividend calendar with upcoming dates

### Event Calendars
- Earnings reports calendar with portfolio-aware highlights
- Economic events calendar
- IPO calendar (Trefolio)
- Interactive month grid view with color-coded event dots

### Broker Import & Sync
- 14 broker CSV formats: DEGIRO, Interactive Brokers, Trading 212, Revolut, Schwab, Fidelity, Nordnet, Tastytrade, Freetrade, eToro, Wealthsimple, Questrade, Firstrade, and Simple CSV
- SnapTrade auto-sync with 20+ brokerages (Trefolio; connection limits per account — see app)
- Auto-sync every 6 hours with dashboard reconnect banner for expired credentials
- AI-powered smart import from screenshots, PDFs, and unstructured data
- Country-aware broker suggestions during onboarding

### AI Analysis (Pro)
- AI Portfolio Review with personalized recommendations
- AI Tax Assistant with country-specific optimization suggestions
- Plain-language stock fundamentals analysis
- News sentiment analysis (bullish/bearish)
- Insider and institutional activity insights
- Economic indicators analysis
- Crypto market AI analysis
- All AI responses in your selected language (35 languages)
- Powered by OpenAI GPT

### Company analysis (`/analisis`)
- Public (no login) ticker research pages at https://trefolio.com/analisis and https://trefolio.com/analisis/{TICKER}
- Aggregated fundamentals, technicals, news, Form 4 / Congress (login for paid sections), and grounded AI narrative
- Live stock price and daily change refresh on every page visit (quote overlay; not day-cached)
- Broader company report cached for 1 day; rebuilt automatically when a visitor opens an expired ticker
- Informational only — trefolio is not a financial advisor; AI narratives may contain errors; not investment advice

### Onboarding & User Experience
- Post-signup onboarding wizard: name, default currency, tax residency, passkey, Google account linking
- Portfolio import step during onboarding (broker connect, CSV, AI import)
- Sample data auto-loaded for users who skip import
- Interactive dashboard tour on first visit and theme changes
- Interactive demo at /demo with no signup required
- In-app notification center (bell icon) for welcome, upgrade/downgrade, and admin broadcasts

### Additional Features
- Crypto portfolio tracking with dedicated tab, transaction management, and market section
- Price alerts (2 free, unlimited for Pro) via email, push, WhatsApp, and trefolio Leaf device
- CSV export of holdings, transactions, and cash balances (Trefolio)
- Multiple portfolios (up to 5 with Trefolio) with switcher and combined view
- Portfolio sharing with public read-only links (Trefolio)
- Stealth mode — hide all monetary values with one click
- 35 European languages
- Privacy-first: no tracking cookies, no data selling, GDPR-compliant
- PWA support (installable on mobile and desktop)
- Native iOS and Android apps via Capacitor
- trefolio Leaf AMOLED desk display with OTA firmware updates

- Up to 20 stocks & ETFs (limits may change — see app)
- Real-time Yahoo Finance quotes
- Historical price charts
- Cash balance tracking
- Benchmark comparison (S&P 500, etc.)
- 14 broker CSV import formats + AI Import
- Portfolio growth projection
- Earnings calendar for your holdings
- Dark & light mode
- 35 European languages
- Limited AI usage per month (token-based)
- Limited price alerts (in-app)

### Trefolio Plan (paid — see landing page for EUR launch vs regular monthly/annual pricing)
Everything in Folio, plus higher limits and premium capabilities, including for example:
- Unlimited or high holdings and AI usage (fair use)
- Tax reports for 17 countries (DE, FR, ES, NL, IT, GB, US, CH, AT, PT, BE, IE, SE, DK, NO, FI, PL)
- AI Tax Assistant with optimization suggestions
- Portfolio simulator (backtesting, what-if scenarios, crisis stress testing)
- Stock screener (600+ stocks, 6 filters, 5 presets)
- Company fundamentals (income, balance, cash flow)
- Stock intelligence (news sentiment, insider trades)
- Economic indicators dashboard
- All 4 dashboard themes (Default, Canvas, Terminal, Studio)
- SnapTrade broker sync (many brokerages)
- IPO calendar
- Up to 5 portfolios
- Price alerts across email, push, WhatsApp, and device
- Full portfolio history and advanced metrics
- Portfolio sharing and CSV export
- Net worth tracking (manual assets)
- trefolio Leaf device support
- Priority support

## Supported Exchanges

NYSE, NASDAQ, XETRA, LSE, Amsterdam (AMS), Madrid (MAD), Copenhagen (OMK), and additional exchanges via Yahoo Finance.

## Technology Stack

- Frontend: Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- Database: Turso (libSQL)
- Hosting: Vercel
- AI: OpenAI GPT
- Payments: Stripe
- Market Data: Yahoo Finance, Alpha Vantage (Pro)
- Broker Sync: SnapTrade
- Mobile: Progressive Web App (PWA) + Capacitor (iOS, Android)

## Data & Privacy

- GDPR-compliant, built in Portugal (EU)
- Passwords hashed with bcrypt
- Sessions use secure HTTP-only cookies
- All data encrypted at rest
- No advertising cookies, no tracking cookies
- Data never sold or shared with third parties
- Users can delete their account and data at any time
- Cookie consent with Consent Mode v2

## Third-Party Services

- Yahoo Finance: real-time market data
- Alpha Vantage: premium market data (Pro)
- OpenAI: AI-powered analysis and tax assistant
- Stripe: payment processing
- SnapTrade: broker auto-sync (20+ brokerages)
- Vercel: hosting and deployment
- Turso (libSQL): database
- Resend: transactional email
- Google Analytics 4: GDPR-compliant analytics with Consent Mode v2

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How do I import my portfolio?
Go to the unified /import page to access all import methods: 14 broker CSV formats (DEGIRO, IBKR, Trading 212, Revolut, Schwab, Fidelity, Nordnet, and more), SnapTrade auto-sync with 20+ brokerages, and AI Import from screenshots or any file. New users are guided through import during onboarding. Broker Sync (SnapTrade) requires Trefolio.

### What CSV formats are supported?
14 broker CSV formats: DEGIRO, Interactive Brokers, Trading 212, Revolut, Schwab, Fidelity, Nordnet, Tastytrade, Freetrade, eToro, Wealthsimple, Questrade, Firstrade, and Simple CSV. For any other format, use AI Import — upload or paste your file and AI will parse it.

### Is my data secure?
Yes. All data is encrypted at rest, passwords are hashed with bcrypt, and sessions use secure HTTP-only cookies. We are GDPR-compliant and built in Portugal (EU). We never sell or share your data with third parties.

### What exchanges are supported?
trefolio supports NYSE, NASDAQ, XETRA, LSE, Amsterdam (AMS), Madrid (MAD), Copenhagen (OMK), and more. Multi-currency conversion between 21 currencies (EUR, USD, GBP, CHF, SEK, NOK, DKK, CAD, AUD, NZD, JPY, and more) is handled automatically.

### How are performance metrics calculated?
TTWROR uses the Modified Dietz method, which weights each cash flow by the fraction of the period remaining — so returns reflect market performance only, not deposit timing. IRR (XIRR) finds the annualized rate that makes the net present value of all dated cash flows equal zero. Advanced metrics (Sharpe, Drawdown, Volatility) are available on Trefolio.

### What's the difference between the plans?
Folio (free) includes up to 20 holdings, real-time quotes, charts, growth projection, broker import, earnings calendar for your holdings, and limited AI usage. Trefolio (paid) is a single subscription that unlocks premium data, higher limits, tax reports, screener, simulator, SnapTrade sync, themes, advanced metrics, and more — see current EUR pricing on the landing page.

### What tax reports are available?
Trefolio includes country-specific tax reports for 17 countries: Germany (Anlage KAP, Vorabpauschale, Teilfreistellung), France (Déclaration 2074), Spain (Modelo 100/720), Netherlands (Box 3), Italy (Quadro RT/RW, IVAFE), UK (CGT), US (Schedule D), Switzerland (Verrechnungssteuer), Austria (KESt), Portugal (IRS Anexo J), Belgium (TOB), Ireland (CGT 33%), Sweden (K4), Denmark (Aktieindkomst), Norway (RF-1159), Finland (capital income 30%), and Poland (PIT-38). Reports include FIFO/LIFO/average cost basis, dividend income, withholding tax, and form field mapping. An AI Tax Assistant provides optimization suggestions.

### Can I cancel anytime?
Yes. Trefolio is billed monthly or annually. You can cancel anytime from the billing portal — your paid features remain active until the end of the billing period.

### How do dividends and fees get tracked?
When you import a broker CSV or connect via SnapTrade, dividends, withholding taxes, and broker fees are parsed automatically. For Simple CSV imports, use the type column with 'dividend' or 'fee' values. All transactions are stored in your ledger and reflected in performance metrics and tax reports.

## LLM & agent integration

Public machine-readable docs for external AI clients:

- Documentation index: https://trefolio.com/api/docs
- OpenAPI 3.1: https://trefolio.com/openapi.json
- Claude Desktop (PAT, not OAuth Client ID): https://trefolio.com/api/docs/claude-desktop — edit `~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json` with `type: http` and `Authorization: Bearer tfp_pat_…`; do NOT use Settings → Connectors → Custom connector OAuth fields
- Warren MOAT guide: https://trefolio.com/api/docs/warren-moat — Buffett-style competitive advantage scoring via MCP tools (`getMoatEvaluation`, `generateMoatNarrative`, `screenMoat`, …) or session REST
- MCP discovery: https://trefolio.com/.well-known/mcp.json — portfolio + MOAT tools with user PAT (`tfp_pat_…`)
- AI plugin manifest: https://trefolio.com/.well-known/ai-plugin.json

Auth: MCP uses Bearer `tfp_pat_…` (mint at user.trefolio.com → Developer). Claude Desktop Custom Connector UI expects OAuth and has no Client ID for trefolio — use the config file guide above. Not financial advice.
